cues: Give moral instruction a larger intellectual element.
Point out the disastrous results of hatred and narrow mindedness in the course of teaching knowledge.
Set every specialist skill inside a wider survey of human life.
Even the best technicians should be good citizens, citizens of the world, not of a sect or nation.
And the final argument: with every increase of knowledge and skill, wisdom becomes more necessary, because more power to realise our purposes means more capacity for evil, if our purposes are unwise.
The world needs wisdom as it has never needed it before.
